data.name: Vengatesh
data.long_meaning: The name Vengatesh is derived from the Tamil language and is a combination of two words - Ven (Lord) and Gatesh (Victory). This name is believed to represent the lord of victory who bestows power, protection, and success upon his devotees.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Vengatesh is a tribute to Lord Murugan, who is believed to be the god of victory, love, and war. It is also believed that the name carries the power and blessings of Lord Shiva, who is the ultimate destroyer and the god of transformation.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Vengatesh is a Master Number, which indicates that the person is a natural leader and has the ability to handle complex situations with ease. They are creative, sensitive, and intuitive, and often have a deep understanding of spiritual matters.
